detailed_descriptions.en: EXPERIENCE SONIC LIKE NEVER BEFORE In search of the missing Chaos Emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Accelerate to new heights and explore vast open zones as you race across the massive Starfall Islands! Battle hordes of powerful enemies with an action-packed combat system, uncover the island's mysteries, and save Sonic's Friends. The Comprehensive Experience Experience Sonic's latest 3D adventure, featuring all game mode and content updates in one package. Beyond Sonic, play also as Tails, Amy, and Knuckles, each with their own unique abilities and fighting styles, in the "Final Horizon" Campaign. Enjoy bonus challenges, costumes, music, and much more via the "Sonic's Birthday Bash" and "Sights, Sound, and Speed" Content Updates. 3D Open Zone Adventure Become Sonic and journey to uncover the mysteries of the remains of an ancient civilization plagued by robotic hordes. Race across five massive overworlds islands - each, a unique action-platforming challenge and loaded with hidden secrets to uncover. Action-Packed Combat System Combine moves such as dodges, parries, counters, and combos with a battle system and set of skill tree upgrades that allow you to fight more strategically than ever before. Against mysterious foes and colossal titans, use the new Cyloop ability to take them down! Additional Bonus Content Get even more out of the entire Sonic Frontiers experience through previously released* bonus content: Explorer's Treasure Box, "Monster Hunter" Collaboration Pack, "Sonic Adventure 2" Shoes, Holiday Cheer Suit, and a special Digital Art Book and Mini Soundtrack. * Adventurer’s Treasure Box not included.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
EXPERIENCE SONIC LIKE NEVER BEFORE

In search of the missing Chaos Emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Accelerate to new heights and explore vast open zones as you race across the massive Starfall Islands! Battle hordes of powerful enemies with an action-packed combat system, uncover the island's mysteries, and save Sonic's Friends.

The Comprehensive Experience

Experience Sonic's latest 3D adventure, featuring all game mode and content updates in one package. Beyond Sonic, play also as Tails, Amy, and Knuckles, each with their own unique abilities and fighting styles, in the "Final Horizon" Campaign. Enjoy bonus challenges, costumes, music, and much more via the "Sonic's Birthday Bash" and "Sights, Sound, and Speed" Content Updates.

3D Open Zone Adventure

Become Sonic and journey to uncover the mysteries of the remains of an ancient civilization plagued by robotic hordes. Race across five massive overworlds islands - each, a unique action-platforming challenge and loaded with hidden secrets to uncover.

Action-Packed Combat System

Combine moves such as dodges, parries, counters, and combos with a battle system and set of skill tree upgrades that allow you to fight more strategically than ever before. Against mysterious foes and colossal titans, use the new Cyloop ability to take them down!

Additional Bonus Content

Get even more out of the entire Sonic Frontiers experience through previously released* bonus content: Explorer's Treasure Box, "Monster Hunter" Collaboration Pack, "Sonic Adventure 2" Shoes, Holiday Cheer Suit, and a special Digital Art Book and Mini Soundtrack.

* Adventurer’s Treasure Box not included.
